text: Cybersecurity is an interdisciplinary field that integrates knowledge from computer science, information security, cryptography, law, and other disciplines. It mainly focuses on the security protection issues during the generation, transmission, storage, and usage of information in the cyber space, aiming to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of network infrastructure, information systems, and data. With the advent of the digital age, security threats such as cyber attacks and data leaks have become increasingly frequent, and this field has become a strategically important area for national development.
